P2A-Q11.model:
In this situation, I compared two numbers. At flight level 250 the flight plan gave 2 hours
45 minutes to Ferndale, and we had 3 hours 10 minutes of fuel on board. That left about
25 minutes over the planned burn, which is inside our final reserve, so continuing was
safe. Crestview was only 40 minutes away, but diverting there would have cost the
passengers a whole day, so I kept it as a backup instead of using it.
In my role as a pilot, when I am held down at a lower level I always do the same three
steps. First I ask the controller how long the restriction will last. Second I take the new
burn figure for that level, not the planned one. Third I subtract it from the fuel on board
and check that what is left is more than my final reserve plus the alternate.
For example, if the burn at the lower level left me with less than my reserve, or if the
weather at destination was marginal, I would divert straight away rather than continue and
arrive with nothing in hand.
notes: **90초 문항 무응답은 혼자서 등급을 내립니다.** EPTA_05 에서 세 문항을 비워 Level 2 로
`Give an example` 은 **8세트 연속** 미수행입니다.
